name: orbit-lock
title: Orbit Lock
description: Moons ride tilted, shrinking orbits into a core that bursts into a ring flash, and the logo springs into place. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .ol-logo element.
useWhen: A tech, AI or infrastructure product needs an opener or closer where the logo arrives out of a small physical event.
You want a sting with a clear impact beat to sync a sound hit to, at 1 s.
avoidWhen: Several partner logos should arrive together as a group.
The reveal should feel cinematic and calm: use anamorphic-flare or spotlight.
author: Remocn

variables.description: Number of moons orbiting the core.
